sentences.text: Rivian went from no revenue in FY2020 to $5,387 million in FY2025, a 48.1% three-year CAGR from FY2022 [F2][F7][D342].
The step change came in FY2022, when revenue jumped 2914.5% to $1,658 million on deliveries of 19,412 vehicles [F4][D83][P67].
Growth then decelerated sharply: 167.4% in FY2023, 12.1% in FY2024 and 8.4% in FY2025 [D135][D187][D239].
The FY2025 slowdown came as deliveries fell 9,332 vehicles, partly on the expiration of 45W tax credits after September 30, 2025 [P22].
In FY2025 Software and Services contributed 21.6pp of the 8.4% revenue growth, while Automotive subtracted 13.2pp [D323][D316][D239].

Software and services revenue rose 221.7% to $1,557 million, driven by vehicle electrical architecture and software development services for the Joint Venture, remarketing and repair [S26][D322][P18].
New electric vehicles fell 12.5% to $3,639 million and were 67.6% of revenue, down from 83.7% in FY2024 [S11][D287][D286][D283].
Automotive revenue fell 14.6% to $3,830 million on lower deliveries and lower regulatory credit sales, partly offset by higher average selling prices [S23][D315][P22].
Operating costs grew 6.9% against 8.4% revenue growth, so incremental operating margin was 264.7% as the loss narrowed [D258][D239][D265].
Gross margin turned positive at 2.7% in FY2025, against a window median of -45.8% and a FY2021 low of -845.5% [F19][D332][D330].
Operating margin improved 27.8pp to -66.5%, still far below the peer median of -1.6% [D253][F31][D344].
Cost of revenue fell 15.0% and added 26.8pp to operating margin, as fewer vehicles were produced and raw material and conversion costs fell [D255][D267][P21].
SG&A subtracted 0.5pp as go-to-market expansion raised payroll, stock-based compensation and facilities expenses [D269][P13].
Net margin of -67.7% sat 1.1pp below operating margin, as a $186 million securities litigation settlement lifted other expense [F43][D359][P10].
Operating cash flow was -$779 million and free cash flow -$2,489 million in FY2025, a -46.2% free-cash-flow margin against a window median of -132.9% [F64][F78][D226][D335].
The operating outflow narrowed from $1,716 million primarily on a significant reduction in net loss [F63][F64][P4].
Capex rose 49.9% to $1,710 million, 31.7% of revenue and 2.18x D&A, on Normal Factory capacity expansion [F71][D246][D225][D228][P3].
Stock-based compensation of $741 million equaled 20.7% of the operating loss, so cash burn understates the economic cost [X56][D237].
Net cash fell to $1,642 million from $3,259 million as cash and investments dropped 21.0% to $6,082 million against $4,440 million of debt [D231][D179][D261][D229][D230].
The current ratio fell to 2.33x, a window low, from a 4.94x median, as current liabilities grew 64.1% [F129][D339][D341][D251].
Cash and investments cover 2.4 years of the latest burn, and operating margin sits at the 25th percentile of four autos peers [D236][D343].
Financing brought in $886 million, mainly $750 million of Class A shares issued to Volkswagen Group, while the diluted share count rose 17.1% [F92][P2][D260].
Rivian has posted a net loss in each of the last seven years, from -$426 million in FY2019 to -$3,646 million in FY2025 [R1][F32][F38].
Stock-based compensation was 13.8% of revenue in FY2025 and at least 10% in each of the last five years [R2][D223][D31].
New electric vehicles, 67.6% of revenue, fell 12.5% in FY2025, and Automotive, 71.1% of revenue, fell 14.6% [R4][R5][D286][D287][D314][D315].
Cash and investments cover only 2.4 years of the latest burn, down from 4.1 years in FY2021 [R3][D236][D44].
Product revenue members sum to 129% of consolidated revenue in FY2025, so segment shares should not be added together [R6].
Whether gross margin holds above the FY2025 level of 2.7% or slips back toward the -24.1% of FY2024, reported in the FY2026 10-K [F19][F18].
Whether operating cash flow narrows past the FY2025 outflow of $779 million toward breakeven, or widens back toward the $1,716 million FY2024 outflow [F64][F63].
Whether the current ratio recovers above the 2.33x FY2025 low or falls further as current liabilities of $3,693 million come due [F129][F117].
